Thought: Now I can calculate Moran's I. The formula is:
I = (n/S0) * (sum_{i,j} w_ij * (y_i - ȳ) * (y_j - ȳ)) / sum_i (y_i - ȳ)^2
where S0 = sum_{i,j} w_ij

# Verify matrix properties
